svg.text: 1. Flat sizes are for 1.5 mm 304 with a 1.5 inside radius and K 0.44. Bend a test strip first and correct BD before cutting the wrap.
2. All DXF files are full size in mm and inch, layers CUT (white), BEND (red, centre of bend), MARK (green, etch the part number).
3. Deburr all cut edges. Grain (#4) runs vertically on the shell and door, front to back on the top.
